title: Luca infra microcommit list
content:
Morning quicklist — capture before meetings

Context: midday micro-commits to keep pools healthy during holiday surge. Personal checklist, rough commands, and triage notes. Not polished; will copy bits to the runbook later.

Top priorities (order matters):
- [ ] Confirm preemptible pool health + expected reclaim window (check preemptible nodes in cluster-a)
- [ ] Drain any nodes with > 5 preempt reasons in last 24h (ticket JIRA-INFRA-982)
- [ ] Bump KV cache TTL for seq length 1024 workloads from 60s -> 120s on stage (quick experiment)
- [ ] Add fallback routing rule to route: low-latency -> dedicated-g4 if hosted-llm qps spike > 1.2x

Quick checks (commands to run)
- kubectl get nodes -o wide | egrep "preempt|g4"
- kubectl describe node <id> | grep -i taint
- nvidia-smi -L (on node) to confirm GPU presence/driver OK
- curl -s "https://metrics.redwood/api/agent/pool/kpi?pool=dedicated-g4&window=1h" | jq .

Small triage notes (observed)
- Two g4 nodes showed repeated ECC warnings last night, but cleared after reboot — track for 24h.
- Batch queue latency spiked at 03:10 UTC for small text-gen jobs; suspect bad batching config (max_batch_wait lower than expected).
- Edge router 12 (eu-west) has a slow healthcheck (timeout 800ms), increasing fallbacks to other regions.

Micro-ops to run now
- ssh jump -> node-g4-17 -> sudo systemctl restart nv_peer_mem.service (only if ECC warnings persist)
- Update autoscaler config: set minReplicas for dedicated-g4 to 6 during payroll-week surge window
- Push quick KV TTL change to stage via infra/ops/k8s-configs (PR: #678) and monitor latency for 30m

Notes to self / reminders
- If reclaim events >3 in 1h, open urgent capacity incident and pin non-prod jobs to g4-burst pool.
- Coordinate with SRE on canary for fallback routing; don't flip global route without their ack.
- Follow up with HW team re: ECC pattern on 2026-03-10 02:xx logs (possible flaky PCI lane)

Meeting prep bullets (standup at 11:30):
- Current spare GPU capacity: ~9% across prod pools (estimate from metric pull at 10:45)
- Planned autoscaler bump + short TTL increase to absorb spike — expected cost delta ~ +4% but lowers risk of SLO misses
- Need approval to run node-reboots on two g4 hosts during maintenance window 12:30-13:00

Quick decisions taken (scratch)
- TTL change pushed to stage (v1) — watch latency for 15m; rollback plan: revert PR 678
- Defer full ASG resize until post-morning-ramp (unless reclaimers step up)

Open questions / TODOs to convert into tickets
- Track whether ECC warnings correlate with specific kernel patch; create ticket with kernel versions + timestamps
- Add synthetic test for prefix-KV cache effectiveness on seq length distribution >512
- Short doc: how to safely bump TTLs without breaking cache coherence across regions

End of note. Will paste relevant lines into incident slack thread if things escalate.

-- Luca
